home.title: Free social media monitoring on your own computer | SocialMonitor
home.description: A free, open-source app that keeps every Instagram, Facebook and TikTok comment on your computer and sorts them with AI.

hero.title: Know what people say about your brand.
hero.lead: SocialMonitor keeps every post and comment from Instagram, Facebook and TikTok on your computer. AI sorts the comments and flags the ones that need a reply.
hero.note: In development, with no release yet. It runs from source today, free and open source.

how.title: From a link to a report.
how.text: SocialMonitor reads the networks through its own browser, which you sign into by hand. It never sees your password.
how.name: Watch a brand's comments with SocialMonitor

add.name: Add a brand
add.text: Paste its profile links on Instagram, Facebook and TikTok.

update.name: Press Update
update.text: Choose the networks, then new posts or all of them. Nothing runs until you do.

sort.name: See every comment sorted
sort.text: Each comment gets a label and the reason for it. Those that need a reply come first.

report.name: Read the report
report.text: A report follows every update. Or ask Claude about your data from any chat.

features.title: The comments that need you, first.
features.text: Every post and comment is kept, described and sorted. You start with what needs an answer.

sort.title: Sorted, with the reason
sort.text: Praise, questions, complaints, suggestions or spam. Each label comes with a line on why.

reply.title: A reply queue
reply.text: Comments that need an answer are flagged and listed first, the most liked on top.

posts.title: Every post described
posts.text: A short description of what each post shows, from its text and cover picture. Videos included.

schedule.title: Manual, or on a schedule
schedule.text: Updates run when you press Update. Schedules are optional: every few hours, daily or at set times.

report.title: Reports, export and import
report.text: A report after every update. Export the whole database as one file, and import it anywhere.

claude.title: Claude, built in
claude.text: A built-in MCP server lets Claude query your data and run updates from any chat.

privacy.title: Your data stays on your computer.
privacy.text: No SocialMonitor server, account or analytics. The database, the browser profile and every report stay on your machine.
privacy.claude: Post and comment text, and each post's cover picture, go to Claude through your own Claude Code or Anthropic API key. That is the one exception.

open.title: Open source, down to the last line.
open.text: Every line is on GitHub under the MIT licence. One command connects Claude Code to your data.
open.codeLabel: The command that connects SocialMonitor to Claude Code

faq.title: Questions, answered.
faq.lead: What people ask before they watch their first brand.

free.a: Yes. There are no plans, limits, trials or accounts, and there never will be. The AI runs on your own Claude Code or Anthropic API key, billed by Anthropic as usual.

data.a: On your computer, in SocialMonitor's data folder. There is no SocialMonitor server. Export and import move the whole database as one file.

ban.a: SocialMonitor only reads: it never posts, likes or follows. It reads slowly, waits at least 4 hours between signed-in reads, and stops at the first captcha. No tool can promise an account is never restricted, so sign in with a spare one.

networks.a: Instagram, Facebook and TikTok. Watch a brand on one network, several or all three.

ai.a: The text of posts and comments, and each post's cover picture. They go to Claude through your own Claude Code or Anthropic API key, and nowhere else.

when.a: SocialMonitor is in development, with no release yet. It runs from source today: the README explains how. Watch the repository to hear about the first release.

install.title: Get SocialMonitor.
install.runText: Clone the repository and start the dashboard on your computer. You need Node 22.18 and Yarn.
install.githubText: Read the code, report a problem or suggest a feature.

privacy.title: Privacy policy | SocialMonitor
privacy.description: Shades Media Group receives nothing. SocialMonitor keeps posts and comments on your computer; only text and cover pictures go to Claude, through your key.
privacy.intro: SocialMonitor is an app you run on your own computer, made by Shades Media Group. This policy covers the app and this website.
privacy.short: Shades Media Group receives nothing. Everything SocialMonitor collects stays on your computer. The one exception is what it asks Claude to read, which goes to Anthropic through your own account.
privacy.appTitle: What the app collects, and where it goes
privacy.appPosts: Posts and comments from the public profiles you add, read through a browser profile on your computer. These include the names and words of the people who comment.
privacy.appStore: It stores them in a database in the data/ folder, on your computer only.
privacy.appClaude: To describe posts and sort comments, their text and each post's cover picture are sent to Claude through the Claude Code or Anthropic API key you configure. Anthropic's privacy policy covers that step.
privacy.appReports: Reports and exports are files you save; they go wherever you put them.
privacy.duties: Comments are personal data. If you run SocialMonitor for an organisation, it is the controller of that data. Watch only profiles you have a reason to watch, keep data no longer than you need (Settings → Keep data for), and respect the networks' terms. Delete a brand to delete all of its posts and comments.
privacy.site: The website is static. It sets no cookies and loads no third-party scripts, fonts or trackers. A display preference you choose stays in your browser.
privacy.heading: Privacy policy
privacy.data: None. There are no accounts, analytics, crash reports or tracking of any kind.
privacy.changes: Changes to this policy are published on this page and noted in the changelog.

consent.title: Your privacy
consent.text: This site keeps only what it needs to work, like your display settings. Analytics or marketing tools would run only with your yes.
consent.necessaryText: Remembers your display and privacy choices. Always on.
consent.analyticsText: Anonymous visit counts, to learn what helps. Not in use on this site today.
consent.marketingText: Ads and campaign measurement. Not in use on this site today.
